ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: Routing a straightforward quantitative task to the model with higher capability scores (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2) is the better bet for accuracy. The task has clear completion criteria, which suits both models, but neither has a relevant preference effect, so capability is the deciding factor and Plover wins it.
